svg.title: Geologist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as geologist, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed geological hammer sits above a low angular rock specimen with one visible sediment layer. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
